Here are a couple of essential tips for a great cup of coffee:

  • Freshly Grind Your Beans: Grinding your coffee beans right before brewing is one of the most impactful things you can do for flavor. Pre-ground coffee loses its aromatic compounds much faster.

  • Water Temperature Matters: The ideal water temperature for brewing is between 195°F and 205°F (90°C - 96°C). Boiling water can extract bitter compounds, while cooler water will result in a weak, under-extracted cup.

  • Water Temperature Matters: The ideal water temperature for brewing is between 195°F and 205°F (90°C - 96°C). Boiling water can extract bitter compounds, while cooler water will result in a weak, under-extracted cup.
